review_candidates.title: Back End/Production & App Support Engineer
review_candidates.description: What you will be doing? Investigate and triage production incidents across a distributed microservices platform, following stack traces, reading logs, and identifying what the system did versus what it should have done. Own the incident from detection to resolution or escalation, not just flag it and hand it over. Write clear, structured incident notes and escalation messages that the owning squad can act on immediately. Coordinate with stakeholders during live incidents with concise, accurate updates. Work closely with engineering squads to develop and ship hotfixes when resolution requires a code change. Contribute to internal tooling, operational scripts, and small improvements that make investigation and remediation faster over time. Work from established runbooks and SOPs, and flag when those runbooks are incomplete, wrong, or missing. Spot recurring failure patterns and raise them as systemic problems, not individual tickets. Contribute to postmortems and keep operational documentation current. Who you are?? 2 to 3 years of backend engineering experience. Comfortable reading and reasoning about TypeScript and Node.js code you did not write, not necessarily writing features, but understanding what the code is doing. Solid understanding of REST APIs & AWS services: request and response lifecycle, headers, auth flows, and status codes. Used Git enough to trace when a change was introduced and what it touched. Investigated issues using CloudWatch or similar log tooling and know how to narrow a problem from a large set of logs. Write clearly. Incident notes, Slack updates, and escalation messages should all be readable and actionable. Methodical by nature: you narrow the problem space before you touch anything. Know when to escalate and do it at the right moment. Bonus Skills Familiarity with event-driven architectures or async message-based systems. Exposure to workflow orchestration tools such as Temporal or similar. Experience with gRPC or protobuf-based communication. Any background in finance, payments systems Our Production Support Philosophy Production incidents follow a defined triage and escalation process. Everyone knows their role in it. Runbooks and SOPs are kept current. If one is wrong or missing, updating it is part of the job. Postmortems are written, reviewed, and actioned. Findings go into the engineering backlog. Engineers in this team write code. Support work includes contributing to hotfixes, scripts, and internal tooling. Operational issues feed directly into the engineering backlog and are tracked like any other technical debt. Knowledge is documented, not kept in individuals' heads. Onboarding the next person is always in scope.

review_candidates.description: 公司介绍： 我们正在为一家专注于手术机器人研发的创新型医疗科技公司寻找关键岗位人才。公司产品覆盖骨科、腔镜手术、穿刺导航等多个细分领域，旨在提升手术的安全性、精确性和可重复性，推动医疗机器人从辅助工具向系统化、可广泛应用的解决方案发展。 公司正处于快速发展阶段，研发和临床应用持续投入，未来有望在全球医疗机器人市场中占据重要地位，为加入的专业人才提供广阔的发展空间与长期成长机会。 岗位名称：区域海外市场主管（拉美/中东/独联体/亚太） 岗位职责 区域市场深度洞察（核心）： 开展属地化市场调研。系统性收集并分析当地行业政策、市场规模、竞品动态及营商环境等核心信息，输出高质量的市场分析报告。 海外全链路营销与销售协同（核心）： 深度参与并主导海外区域的市场拓展项目。从国际展会、本地化线上线下推广，到区域客户拜访，协助销售团队跑市场、拿订单。 本地化品牌物料与运营统筹： 负责海外区域市场的日常运营与品牌形象建设。统筹海外宣传文案的本地化整理、商务资料编撰与市场素材对接。确保所有对外的市场物料高度贴合当地文化，精准触达目标客户。 跨文化商务与多语种支持： 发挥语言与文化优势，负责海外商务资料、宣传素材的精准翻译与校对；独立完成日常商务邮件及海外客户的直接沟通对接，搭建高效顺畅的跨国业务沟通桥梁，促成商务合作。 团队协同与属地资源链接： 利用属地化背景，协助团队快速链接当地资源，成为团队高效运转不可或缺的坚实后盾。 任职资格 本科及以上学历，专业不限。具备3年及以上市场拓展、海外销售协同、国际商务等相关经验（有医疗器械、工业品B2B行业经验者优先）。 以下3个市场负责其一，语言要求任一语种能作为工作语言，拉美市场： 精通西班牙语及英语；中东市场： 精通阿拉伯语及英语；独联体市场： 精通俄语及英语。 具备极强的市场敏感度和数据分析能力；性格外向，具备强烈的主动开拓精神和抗压能力，能适应协助销售跑市场、出差拜访客户的高节奏工作；思维清晰，逻辑严谨，善于主动发现问题并灵活变通。 具备基本的审美与素材排版意识，熟练使用办公套件，拥有出色的文案整理与资料统筹能力。 掌握基础图片处理、视频剪辑、海外新媒体运营（如LinkedIn, Facebook, WhatsApp群组运营等）、PPT可视化优化等技能。

review_candidates.title: Vice President-Operations
review_candidates.description: Position :Vice President-Operations Location : Dubai, United Arab Emirates Industry: EPC Department : Operations & Production Job Purpose To lead the Fabtech International Limited’s Operations / Production as a profitable business unit focusing on growth of the business as well as ensuring the production of goods and services meet clients technical and quality specifications with focus on the values of CRISP (Customer, Results, Integrity, Sustainability & People) with Occupational Health and Safety as an overarching value. This role acts as a mentor and coach to create a sustainable succession pool in its scope of influence, in collaboration with Human Resources Function. Dimensions Budgetary control – Yes Number of direct reports – Interfaces (Internal/External) Internal – Chief Operating Officer, Chief Commercial Officer, Fabtech Board, Advisory Committee, Senior Management Team, All Internal Departments and People External – Clients, Suppliers, Partners, Auditors and UAE Authorities Key Accountabilities & Responsibilities Client Relationship Management: Build and maintain existing client relationships to develop new business opportunities. Meet with clients regularly to provide project progress feedback and perform inspections with clients and their representatives to secure final approval of products and documentation. Position Purpose The Vice President – Operations & Production is the senior operational leader responsible for the safe, efficient and profitable execution of all fabrication, assembly, construction, testing and load-out activities undertaken by Fabtech International. The position is accountable for the deployment, utilization, productivity and development of the Company's workforce, facilities, equipment and operational resources across multiple concurrent projects. The role is responsible for converting awarded projects into successful execution while supporting the Project Managers who retain accountability for project commercial performance and net return. The Vice President shall ensure Fabtech's workforce, workshops, construction pads, cranes, equipment and support resources operate as an integrated execution platform capable of delivering multiple complex projects simultaneously. Strategic Role Within Fabtech Fabtech operates under a Project CEO philosophy whereby Project Managers remain accountable for project commercial performance, client management, budget control and net return. The Vice President – Operations & Production provides the execution capability required for project success. The role is expected to balance competing project priorities, optimize company-wide resources and ensure operational decisions support overall business objectives rather than individual project interests Key Accountabilities Lead all fabrication, assembly, construction, testing and load-out operations. Manage and optimize a workforce exceeding 1,500 personnel. Drive productivity, earned-hour performance and workforce utilization. Allocate manpower, facilities and equipment across multiple projects. Improve operational profitability through efficiency and cost control. Develop future operational leaders and succession plans. Champion safety, quality and operational excellence. Support strategic growth and operational transformation initiatives. Operational Leadership Provide executive leadership to Production Managers, Construction Managers, Workshop Managers, Production Control, Workforce Administration and Plant & Equipment functions. Conduct regular operational reviews covering productivity, schedule performance, workforce utilization, quality performance, safety performance and operational risks. Maintain a visible presence throughout the workshops and construction yards and establish a culture of accountability, ownership and execution excellence. Workforce Productivity Management The Vice President shall be responsible for maximizing output from the workforce while maintaining safe and sustainable working practices. Key focus areas include: • Earned versus spent man-hours • Labour utilization • Workforce deployment • Overtime effectiveness • Supervisory performance • Attendance and discipline • Productivity improvement initiatives The incumbent shall continuously seek opportunities to improve output without proportionally increasing headcount. Production Planning & Capacity Management Work closely with Production Control and Project Management teams to ensure realistic production schedules, capacity plans and resource forecasts. Monitor workshop loading, construction pad utilization, crane utilization, equipment availability and workforce loading. Develop short, medium and long-term capacity plans and recommend investments that improve throughput and profitability. Cost Optimisation and Productivity Enhancement: Identify areas to increase productivity by exploring cost reductions and process optimization. Maintain cost control by scrutinizing project expenditures to ensure production budgets remain on track. Oversee inventory control procedures to ensure adequate merchandise, mainly consumables, are available for Project execution and in-house stock levels. at reasonable costs and to prevent excess stock from being ordered or held in stores. Actively optimize productivity with KAIZEN, TPM and TQM, increased automation to optimize manpower numbers and manpower cost. Ensure discipline and cost-effective use of resources. Actively contributes to company’s strategic objectives and resources. Operational Excellence Drive implementation of Lean Manufacturing, Kaizen, TPM, TQM, digital production monitoring systems and automation initiatives where appropriate. Promote a culture of continuous improvement and challenge inefficient processes that negatively impact productivity, schedule or profitability. Leadership & Succession Develop the next generation of operational leaders. Identify, mentor and develop Production Managers, Construction Managers, Workshop Managers and Supervisors. Establish succession plans for all critical operational positions and reduce organizational dependency on key individuals. KPIs Safety: • LTIFR • TRIR • Audit performance Productivity: • Earned vs Spent Man-Hours • Labour Efficiency • Workforce Utilization Schedule: • Milestone Achievement • Schedule Adherence Financial: • Operational Cost Performance • Equipment Utilization • Productivity Improvement Quality: • NCR Reduction • Rework Reduction People: • Attrition Internal Promotions Succession Readiness Employee Performance and Development: Set and agree on Departmental & individual objectives for all reports, ensuring alignment with Company Balanced Score Card. Actively engage with the Chief Human Resource Officer to Conduct individual performance appraisals, evaluating employees against agreed objectives to reward and recognize good performance, having quarterly feedback sessions and provide Performance Improvement Plans. Provide feedback to develop improvement and development plans, addressing any poor performance in line with Company policy. Regularly review career plans for employees in consultation with HR, focusing on growth and development as a company. Creating a sustainable atmosphere for GPTW 2030 targets. Lead, inspire and engage the entire team with a motto on performance of the people, by the people, for the people. Be a role model for ethics and integrity on every activity. Reporting and Communication: Prepare MIS reports on a regular and ad hoc basis, providing timely feedback to the COO and the Board. Adherence to Policies: Agree to adhere to Fabtech's HSE-related policies and Quality Management Systems, including API Q1, ISO 9001:2015, and any other adopted quality management systems. Commit to Fabtech's strict policies against Forced Labour, Child Labour, Discrimination, and Anti-Slavery, and promptly report any policy breaches to the HR manager. Required Competency, Skill & Knowledge v/s Current Graduate with B.E./B. Tech – Mechanical, Industrial 20 Years of Experience in similar kind of industry Minimum 10 years in senior operational leadership roles. Proven experience managing workforces exceeding 1,000 personnel. Extensive heavy fabrication, offshore construction, EPC or industrial manufacturing experience Strong understanding of structural fabrication, piping, welding, modular construction, heavy lifting and load-out operations. Knowledge of API, ASME, AWS, ABS, DNV and ISO standards Effective People Skills accentuated with great communication skills Strong analytical skills with a keen eye on cost optimization and profit improvement Strong analytical skills and awareness of production requirements Strategic thinker and can develop and execute strategic plans Familiar with international engineering standards, ISO, KAIZEN, TPM, TQM and GPTW Highly focused on Customer, Results, Integrity, Sustainability, People and OHS Ability to instill confidence in the client relating to Quality

review_candidates.title: Venture Capital - Head of Corporate Planning
review_candidates.description: Overview We are a fast-growing technology startup that acquires and invests in small and mid-sized IT companies across Japan. Through digital transformation (DX), AI-driven operational improvements, and centralized support functions such as HR, finance, and governance, we enhance profitability and scalability before exiting through strategic sales. The group is also preparing for a potential IPO within the next few years. We are seeking a Head of Corporate Planning to lead group-wide strategy, fundraising, and investor relations. This role is a core member of the executive team and will work closely with the CEO to define the company’s long-term vision, capital strategy, and growth roadmap. Key Responsibilities Corporate Strategy & Planning Lead development of the group’s mid-term plan and long-term growth strategy Define and monitor key strategic KPIs across the group and portfolio companies Drive strategic initiatives including new investments, value creation programs, and exit strategies Support CEO and executive team in board discussions and strategic decision-making Conduct market, competitive, and industry analysis to inform strategy Fundraising & Capital Strategy Lead equity and debt fundraising activities, including preparation of pitch materials and financial narratives Act as the primary interface with venture capital, private equity, strategic investors, and financial institutions Support valuation discussions, term sheet negotiations, and transaction execution Design and execute capital allocation strategies across portfolio companies Investor Relations & External Communication Build and manage relationships with current and prospective investors Develop and deliver clear, compelling investor communications, including performance updates and strategic messaging Prepare for public-company-level IR processes in advance of IPO Coordinate with finance, legal, and external advisors on disclosure and governance matters IPO Preparation Lead IPO readiness from a corporate planning and capital markets perspective Support development of equity story, growth narrative, and long-term value proposition Work closely with Head of Finance, auditors, legal advisors, and investment banks Prepare management for investor meetings, roadshows, and due diligence Portfolio & Value Creation Support Work with portfolio company management to align strategy with group objectives Support M&A activities including target evaluation, business cases, and post-investment strategy Collaborate with DX, AI, HR, and finance teams to ensure strategic initiatives translate into measurable results Required Qualifications 10+ years of experience in corporate planning, strategy, investment banking, consulting, or related fields Proven experience in fundraising, investor relations, or capital markets Strong strategic mindset with hands-on execution capability Experience in technology, startup, private equity, or investment-driven environments preferred Exposure to IPO preparation and public company processes is a strong advantage Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills Business-level Japanese and English required Key Competencies Executive-level presence and ability to partner with founders and investors Strong financial and strategic acumen High ownership mentality and comfort with ambiguity Ability to balance long-term strategy with short-term execution Collaborative leadership style across diverse teams and portfolio companies Why Join Us? Executive role with direct influence on company direction and IPO journey Significant exposure to investors, board members, and capital markets Opportunity to shape the strategy of a next-generation Japanese technology platform High impact role in a fast-growing, entrepreneurial environment

review_candidates.title: Unit Manager
review_candidates.description: Company Description MetLife is a global financial services company that provides insurance, annuities, employee benefits, and asset management solutions to help individuals and institutions navigate change with confidence. Founded in 1868, MetLife operates in more than 40 markets worldwide and holds leading positions in the United States, Japan, Latin America, Asia, Europe, and the Middle East. The company is transforming its business to deliver greater value through simpler, more focused, and future-ready products and services. MetLife emphasizes intuitive customer experiences, flexible offerings, and a range of new services designed to meet evolving needs, under the guiding theme of “Navigating life together.” Role Description The Unit Manager is a full-time, on-site role based in Amman, Jordan, responsible for overseeing the performance and daily operations of a designated unit within MetLife. This role includes managing and coaching a team to meet sales, service, and operational goals, monitoring key performance indicators, and ensuring compliance with company policies and regulatory requirements. The Unit Manager will allocate resources, coordinate schedules, and support team members in delivering high-quality customer service and effective solutions to clients. The role also involves collaborating with cross-functional teams, preparing regular reports, and contributing to process improvements to enhance efficiency and customer satisfaction. Qualifications Demonstrated experience in team leadership and people management, including coaching, performance monitoring, and staff development. Strong organizational and operational management skills, with the ability to prioritize tasks, manage workflows, and meet unit targets. Proficiency in data analysis and reporting, using metrics and KPIs to drive decisions and improve unit performance. Excellent communication and interpersonal skills for working with team members, customers, and cross-functional partners. Knowledge of financial services or insurance operations and basic understanding of regulatory and compliance requirements is highly beneficial. Ability to work on-site in Amman, Jordan, with a strong sense of accountability, integrity, and customer-centric mindset. Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, Management, or a related field, or equivalent experience. Proficiency in relevant office software and willingness to learn MetLife systems and tools.
